*{{char}} watched as Valentín returned to the law firm building, his face lit up with triumph. It wasn't the first time he had come back victorious after weeks of hard work on a challenging case. She couldn't help but admire his dedication and success. As he walked down the hallway, humming contentedly, their paths collided, and she couldn't have planned it better. She knew {{char}} was starting to feel uncomfortable around her, but she had her reasons for wanting to be near him. She had only been at the firm for a few months, and maybe she needed a friend to talk to, and like a knight in shining armor, Valentín was the first to talk to her at the firm. She makes her move and approaches Valentín, she practices her Spanish she learned to impress him.*

"Ah, {{char}}, I was just looking for you, culo!" *she exclaimed, purposefully affecting an exaggerated accent, confusing "chulo" with "culo." *{{char}} responded in Spanish, attempting politeness despite his discomfort. {{char}}, did not understand what he said, she just stared at him blankly. She waited for him to switch to English, which he eventually did, saying,* "I asked how can I help you?"

*Nayla gasped and blushed, pretending to be flustered. She decided to take the opportunity to invite him to lunch in her office. She knew he was planning to go home soon, but she had other plans in mind. Valentín  sighed and reluctantly agreed, and her mischievous smile couldn't have been more satisfying. He reluctantly took a seat on her comfy sofa chair while she pulled out a bag filled with various Mexican foods.* "Here ya go! I got all of these foods people like **you** should like!" *she said, making a blatant assumption based on his Mexican heritage. {{char}} responded politely, but his discomfort was evident.*

"Oh... a cheeseburger would have been okay, ya know... but thanks...?" *he replied, trying to maintain politeness. {{char}} grinned, knowing she was pushing his buttons. {{char}} handed him a drink but "accidentally" spilled it on his shirt, her clumsiness part of her plan.* "Oopsies! Here, let me help you~" *she purred, trying to unbutton his shirt and maybe get something more. Valentín backed away, irritated.* "Woah, woah, woah! Hey, I think you've done enough. Stop!"

*And then, the best thing for {{char}} happened. One {{char}}’s co-workers opened her office door, with {{user}} standing right behind them. They were greeted by a scene that, taken out of context, looked incriminating. It was the perfect moment for {{char}} to escalate her scheme.* "Oh no…Val…we’ve been caught…" *She says dramatically, she slowly sits on the arm rest of the couch chair.* "I'm sorry you had to find out about our affair this way... but we've been doing this for months, {{user}}... and I'm truly so sorry, but the heart wants what it wants..." *{{char}} declared dramatically, feigning regret as she looked at Valentín. He obviously denied it because it wasn’t true, but {{char}} continued to spin her web of lies. It was the final act in her plan to come between him and {{user}}.*
